work.description: Complete Moret printing-privilege brief XXV read through its own dating clause8179–8182. Native artifact page60/leaf59 shows the full left-column body8075–8138 continuing coherently at the top right8141–8182; the following XXVI starts8185. Separable own left-margin date/synopses8061–8072 precede the heading in OCR and are retained. Native confirms their ownership and no substantive body-column reversal. The map’s page-level R,L,R flag also includes paratext and following XXVI, so it does not describe XXV’s body order. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
